test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: VR Chaudhari was appointed to which post in September 2021?

options.text: Air Officer in Charge of Personnel

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief of the Air Staff.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Air Chief Marshal **Vivek Ram Chaudhari** took over as the **Chief of the Air Staff** (CAS) on 30 September 2021.
 
• He is the **27th Chief of the Air Staff** of the Indian Air Force. 
 
• He took over the charge from his predecessor RKS Bhadauria.
 
• The appointments for the post are made by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces (President) : **Droupadi Murmu** (Article 52)
 
• Union Defence Minister: **Rajnath Singh**
 
• Chief of Army Staff (COAS): **Manoj Pandey**
 
• Chief of Naval Staff (CNS): **R Harikumar**

**(as of May 2022)**
